function.name: dacomp_query_db
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_price FROM basic_drug_information b LEFT JOIN pricing_system p ON b.\"Drug ID\" = p.\"Drug ID\" WHERE p.\"Drug ID\" IS NULL"}

function.name: dacomp_query_db
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT b.\"Drug ID\", COUNT(i.\"Inventory ID\") AS inv_cnt, COUNT(p.\"Price ID\") AS price_cnt FROM basic_drug_information b LEFT JOIN inventory_management i ON b.\"Drug ID\" = i.\"Drug ID\" LEFT JOIN pricing_system p ON b.\"Drug ID\" = p.\"Drug ID\" GROUP BY b.\"Drug ID\" HAVING inv_cnt > 1 OR price_cnt > 1 LIMIT 10"}
